bios.short: John Menerick is an independent Principal Security Engineer with 18+ years in information security, focused on AI and agent security, cloud-scale detection and response, zero-trust architecture, and confidential computing.
bios.long:
John Menerick is an independent Principal Security Engineer based in Castro Valley, California, with 18+ years in information security across financial services, technology companies, startups, and the public sector. His work covers AI and agent security, cloud-scale detection and response, zero-trust architecture, and confidential computing across AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. His personal research covers tamper-evident, ephemeral zero-trust workloads on OCI NVIDIA A100 80 GB GPU clusters.

He has been the first security hire at several companies, building application and product security programs, secrets and machine-identity platforms, and automated incident response. As a researcher he finds vulnerabilities in widely used software and coordinates their disclosure, holds a Black Badge, and has spoken at DEF CON, Chaos Communication Camp, and ISC2. Outside work he volunteers with the Alameda County Sheriff's Office of Emergency Services Communications Team and holds an FCC Amateur Extra license (W8MEJ).
